businessDays: Monday to Friday in Asia/Dubai, excluding the UAE holiday list held in the app
dueOffsetBasis: Step 1 counts from case opening; every later step counts from the day the previous step is done

playbooks.name: Technology licensing (Push)
playbooks.trigger: The ED selects a technology from the uVENTURE portfolio for active marketing. The case owner opens an opportunity carrying the technology's uVENTURE record link.

workPackages.title: Technical assessment
workPackages.objective: Establish whether the technology is mature and protected enough to license.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Assessment note on SharePoint, linked from the work package: TRL, IP status, remaining development, researcher commitment.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Note covers all four points, the researcher has confirmed the facts, and the reviewer has signed off.

workPackages.title: Commercial route scoping
workPackages.objective: Choose the route to market: licence, option, or co-development.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Route recommendation with rationale, target sectors, deal type and indicative value range.
workPackages.doneCriteria: One route recommended with rationale, target sectors named, and the ED's gate decision recorded.

workPackages.title: Partner shortlist
workPackages.objective: Identify the companies most likely to take the technology on the chosen route.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Ranked shortlist of companies in Twenty, each with a named contact and a fit rationale.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Every shortlisted company exists in Twenty with at least one named contact and a fit rationale, and the reviewer has approved the list.

workPackages.title: Outreach
workPackages.objective: Bring at least one shortlisted partner into a negotiation.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Logged contact with every shortlisted partner and the status of each.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Every shortlisted partner is contacted and logged as in discussion, declined, or closed; one partner has agreed to negotiate terms, or none remain.

additional.description: No response from a shortlisted partner after 10 business days creates a follow-up task for the BD officer.
A second 10 business days of silence marks that partner closed.

workPackages.title: Term sheet
workPackages.objective: Agree headline terms with the partner.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Term sheet on SharePoint, approved internally, issued to the partner, linked from the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: ED, legal and finance approvals recorded, term sheet issued, and the partner's acceptance or counter logged.

workPackages.title: Licence signed
workPackages.expectedOutput: Licence signed by both parties, stored on SharePoint, linked from the opportunity.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Executed agreement on SharePoint, contract metadata (counterparty, type, status, key dates, value, owner) entered in Twenty, and uVENTURE records updated.

gates.evidence: Assessment note: TRL, IP status, researcher commitment.
Route recommendation with target sectors and indicative value.

gates.when: before the term sheet is issued
gates.evidence: Draft term sheet, legal review, finance view of value.

exits.label: Lost
exits.meaning: The ED stops the case at a gate, or every shortlisted partner has declined or been closed.

exits.label: Parked
exits.meaning: No live partner conversation for 30 business days, or the patent position is pending. The ED reviews parked cases every 3 months.

uventureHandoffs.action: Set status to under active marketing when the case opens.
Record the licence against the patent.

playbooks.name: RFQ / technical service (Pull)
playbooks.trigger: An RFQ or technical service request reaches the BD mailbox or a BD officer. The BD officer logs an opportunity the same business day, with the client deadline.

anchors.label: client deadline
anchors.source: Entered by the case owner when logging the opportunity.

workPackages.title: Bid or no-bid
workPackages.expectedOutput: Recommendation assessed against capability, capacity in the requested window, margin, deadline feasibility and strategic fit.
workPackages.doneCriteria: All five criteria assessed and the ED's decision recorded; a no-bid closes the case as Lost with the reason.

additional.description: If the default offsets put submission later than 2 business days before the client deadline, the case owner escalates to the ED.

workPackages.title: Scoping
workPackages.objective: Define the technical work the client needs.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Scope: tasks, method, equipment, staff time, assumptions, exclusions.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Scope covers every RFQ requirement or lists the exceptions, effort is estimated in person-days, and the reviewer has signed off.

workPackages.title: Quote or proposal
workPackages.objective: Price the work and write the response.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Quote or proposal on SharePoint, linked from the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Price built from the scoped effort with finance input, every RFQ requirement answered, and finance has reviewed it.

workPackages.title: Internal approval
workPackages.expectedOutput: ED approval recorded on the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Approval recorded, or the response sent back with reasons.

workPackages.title: Submission
workPackages.objective: Deliver the response to the client before the deadline.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Submission confirmation (email or portal receipt) linked from the work package.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Submitted before the client deadline, confirmation linked, and the reviewer has checked it.

workPackages.title: Follow-up
workPackages.expectedOutput: Client decision logged: award, decline, or postponed.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Client decision logged, or three unanswered follow-ups logged and the case Parked.

additional.description: Every 5 business days without a decision creates a follow-up task for the BD officer.
After 3 unanswered follow-ups the case is marked Parked.

workPackages.title: Delivery hand-off
workPackages.objective: Hand the won work to the delivery team.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Project in Twenty owned by a developer, with scope, PO link, client contacts and dates.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Project accepted by its developer owner and kick-off held within 5 business days of the PO.

gates.evidence: Capability, capacity in the requested window, margin, deadline feasibility, strategic fit.
Scope, price with finance review, and the response document.

exits.label: Signed
exits.meaning: PO or contract received; delivery hand-off follows.

exits.label: Lost
exits.meaning: No-bid, or the client awards the work elsewhere.

exits.label: Parked
exits.meaning: The client postpones, or there is no response after three follow-ups.

playbooks.name: Industry workshop
playbooks.trigger: The ED approves a workshop topic, from the annual plan or a partner request. The case owner opens a project at least 40 business days before the event date.

anchors.label: event
anchors.source: Set by the case owner at the objective step.

workPackages.title: Objective
workPackages.objective: Set what the workshop is for and how success is measured.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Short brief: topic, date, target sectors, technologies or capabilities shown, target number of opportunities.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Topic, date and target outcomes approved by the ED.

workPackages.title: Audience and target roles
workPackages.expectedOutput: Target list of named people in the roles CEO, CTO, R&D head and innovation manager, each a person record in Twenty linked to a company.
workPackages.doneCriteria: At least 30 invitees per 10 expected attendees, every invitee in Twenty with company and role, and the reviewer has approved the list.

workPackages.title: Invitations
workPackages.expectedOutput: Invitations sent and a registration list kept current.
workPackages.doneCriteria: All invitations sent no later than 20 business days before the event, and registrations tracked against the target list.

workPackages.title: Logistics
workPackages.objective: Prepare venue, agenda, speakers and materials.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Venue, catering and AV booked, agenda with researcher presenters confirmed, materials ready, spend approved.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Everything confirmed in writing, spend approved by the ED after finance review, and the reviewer has checked it.

workPackages.title: Run
workPackages.objective: Hold the workshop and capture interest.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Attendance recorded and interest notes logged against each attendee in Twenty.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Event held, attendance recorded on person records, and every follow-up request or stated problem noted against the attendee.

workPackages.title: Outcomes into opportunities
workPackages.objective: Turn every expression of interest into owned work.
workPackages.expectedOutput: Each lead (an attendee who asked for a follow-up or named a problem) becomes an opportunity on the Push or Pull playbook, or gets a logged "no fit" note; lead and opportunity counts recorded on the project.
workPackages.doneCriteria: Every lead has an opportunity with owner, next action and date, or a "no fit" note; lead and opportunity counts are recorded on the project, zero included; industry challenges are recorded in uVENTURE and linked.

gates.evidence: Brief with topic, date and target outcomes.

exits.label: Cancelled
exits.meaning: Workshop called off at a gate or by the ED.

exits.label: On hold
exits.meaning: Workshop postponed with no new date.

uventureHandoffs.action: Create a record for each industry challenge raised, and put its link on each resulting opportunity.
